points.description: Forms the augmented third-order model with the integral state included (e.g. x=[θ θ̇ ξ], ξ̇=r−θ, θ̈=−(c+bk1)θ−(a+bk2)θ̇+bK_Iξ, or equivalent Acl matrix). Either sign convention accepted if consistent.
Correct symbolic closed-loop characteristic polynomial s³+(a+bk2)s²+(c+bk1)s+bK_I.
All three gains correct by coefficient matching: k1=18, k2=6, K_I=32. (If the student uses ξ̇=r−θ with −K_Iξ, K_I=−32 is accepted if the convention is stated and algebra consistent.)

rubric.notes: One mark each for the augmented model, the symbolic characteristic polynomial, the desired polynomial, and the correct three gains. No part marks; each point is all or nothing. A different valid method (e.g. Routh or Laplace transfer function) that gives the same polynomial earns the marks.
rubric.answer_key: Augmented model: θ̈=−(c+bk1)θ−(a+bk2)θ̇+bK_Iξ, ξ̇=r−θ. Characteristic polynomial: s³+(a+bk2)s²+(c+bk1)s+bK_I. Desired: (s+4)(s²+4s+8)=s³+8s²+24s+32. With a=2,b=1,c=6: 2+k2=8 → k2=6; 6+k1=24 → k1=18; K_I=32. Final: k1=18, k2=6, K_I=32.
